question: Does a fixed full-factorial pair design at the upstream motif explain the exploratory risk-pair advantage?
action_rule: Four pair interventions on motif 0 at (-2,-2), (-2,+2), (+2,-2), (+2,+2), then one pair intervention on motif 1 at (-2,-2)
development_decision: Report all three paired values and action/cost parity. This reused-system screen cannot promote a claim. If the fixed factorial control approaches or beats risk, design a fresh confirmation with a frozen contrast; otherwise investigate full learner information before submitting more systems.
limits: The fixed design concentrates on motif 0 and is not motif-coverage matched. All systems use the same synthetic family and no language-model prior.
